source_tree.definition: The clean local digest is the source of record; hosted jobs create only their own redirected report output outside this source-of-record digest.

failed_attempt.macos_failure: Several renderer workers exceeded the 20-second timeout when all 27 artifacts were launched concurrently.
failed_attempt.windows_failure: The hard-coded /tmp temporary root was unavailable on Windows (ENOENT from mkdtemp).
failed_attempt.disposition: Fixed with host-native tmpdir() and a bounded four-worker audit queue; no compatibility status changed.

run.checks: Every pinned main.js artifact and the mediated renderer fixture completed the isolated renderer lifecycle probe on all three hosted platforms; all report summaries passed with zero ordinary renderer failures.

limitation: This matrix proves only cross-platform isolated renderer lifecycle behavior and unchanged artifact integrity. It does not certify stock Obsidian, same-user OS isolation against a hostile extension, reference settings/views/workflows, human behavior, provider-backed behavior, required combinations, signing, publication, updater behavior or compatibility promotion.

result: All 27 pinned plugin/dependency artifacts completed cross-platform isolated lifecycle probes with unchanged-byte integrity checks, 23 explicit renderer denials, four loaded lifecycle traces and one non-applicable theme dependency; the evidence remains non-certifying and no plugin or compatibility row was promoted.
